submission_fields.label: Short description
submission_fields.value: Synapse Network Remote MCP lets AI agents discover payable APIs, invoke approved paid tools with bounded USDC spend, and retrieve receipts.
submission_fields.notes: Include Remote MCP, paid API discovery, spend bounds, USDC settlement, and receipts.

submission_fields.label: GitHub repository URL
submission_fields.notes: Use the public SynapseNetworkAI MCP repository.

submission_fields.label: NPM package
submission_fields.notes: Leave unchanged unless the published package name changes.

submission_fields.label: Remote MCP endpoint
submission_fields.notes: If the form lacks this field, include it in the description.

submission_fields.label: Tools
submission_fields.notes: If the form lacks this field, include these in the description.

submission_fields.label: Docs URL
submission_fields.notes: Use as the documentation/reference URL when available.

submission_fields.label: Contact email
submission_fields.notes: Operator-owned email only; required when the directory form asks for contact or account email; do not enter API keys or bearer tokens.

submission_steps: Open the existing public listing or directory account in an operator-owned browser session.
Update the listing description or metadata with the Remote MCP endpoint, GitHub repository, npm package, docs URL, and tool names.
Capture the saved-update receipt or screenshot before recording evidence.
Rerun the source-host live spot-check; do not run GPT/Claude success probes until the spot-check reports a complete candidate or live listing.
evidence_recording_steps: Use evidence-mode submission-confirmation for the metadata refresh receipt or screenshot.
Use evidence-mode live-listing only after the public listing includes the missing Synapse terms.
Rerun unchanged ChatGPT/Claude/Grok/Gemini probes only after the refreshed listing is live.
live_listing_validation_steps: Open the search URLs and confirm a public listing page, not only a submitted form receipt.
Verify the public page includes Synapse Network, the Remote MCP endpoint, GitHub or npm, and at least one tool name.
Record the public listing with record_ai_visibility_source_host_execution.py --surface glama --evidence-mode live-listing --source-url <public-listing-url>.
Rerun the unchanged answer-engine probe matrix only after live-listing evidence is recorded.
